reviewed_contracts.finding: Science and delivery binding identities remain distinct. Published readback flag, exact files/size/SHA256/Gitblob, duplicate/conflicting declarations and template/module membership are checked before any compiler/science job.

The first actual invocation creates one JOB_MANIFEST without overwrite. Future invocations reconstruct it using the original resource observation, width, toolchain provenance, paths, template, bindings and Python bytes. Canonical inequality refuses resume; changing current owner load cannot silently alter identities or replay a completed performance job.
Preflight-only creates an unsealed proposal, not a production width seal. NCP-only template prevents non-preflight sandbox execution. Existing sealed profile cannot change for actual run.

Configured64CPU/128GiB is a ceiling, reduced by affinity/cgroup capacity and observed owner load. Case width is fixed once, current availability is used for admission/defer only. Per-job time cap1800s, disk cap4GiB, owner process exclusion and exact PASS resume remain inherited from existing reviewed runner.

Private fallback pins official Rust1.94.1 archive URL/bytes/SHA. Only minimal regular files are extracted; unsafe/duplicate/traversal member paths fail. Each cached member and exact executable set is reread. Existing version/hash-identified toolchain does not claim archive identity.

Toolchain stage bounds affinity to at most2 CPUs and uses1770s alarm, disk admission, fixed probe subprocess timeout/address-space/file budgets. run_owned controls only newly created process groups; signal/alarm/affinity state is restored in finally blocks.
A resumed sealed toolchain is verified in place and cannot be silently replaced. Optional different rustc/cargo paths fail. Exact ready receipt and member set are required for private cache.

After a valid resolved manifest, local bundle includes declared source/input files and every attempt, including failure/interruption. Full ZIP bytes/CRC/manifest are checked. Packaging status is kept distinct from scientific status and no provider upload occurs.

Final launch.py and toolchain.py set sys.dont_write_bytecode=True before local imports. This final delta avoids source-checkout __pycache__ writes without changing physics/runtime job source identities.

limitations: This is static review only; no new launcher/toolchain/compiler/solver calls were made here.
NCP hardware and extended production jobs remain unobserved/NOT_RUN.
Read-only full remote Git authenticity is established by separately published source readback, not local flags alone.
The minimal private archive bootstrap full positive network/extraction path is not runtime tested in this review.
